g.text: FlowLab | changing the window changes the distribution
Same joint-density evaluations. Outer window [-4,4]; aligned inner window [-1,1], re-normalized.
Ink: outer-interval density. Teal: inner-interval density, not a crop. 513 evaluations per panel; no re-evaluation.
Mass ratios describe the interpolant inside the finite outer window. Whole-line tails and missed peaks unknown.
Adversarial non-neural test: grids17/33 both estimate integral0.0001; analytic narrow-peak integral is0.5001.
Grid agreement is not an accuracy certificate. No automatic interval selection or calibrated coverage claim.
